notes.title: ¡Nos vemos en la EVA!
notes.content: [p]'Good News' will be present at the Argentinian Videogames Expo 2025.[/p][p]I'll see you on November 7th and 8th at Buenos Aires. I'll be waiting for you to come play the game and chat![/p][p]More info on the [url="https://expoeva.com/en/"]official website[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604820/e543db43816df8020ff3c819a06e3be36c14526e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Good News is on Tiny Teams!
notes.content: [p]I'm so excited to share that 'Good News' is part of such a great festival![/p][p]Go check all the amazing discounts and the wonderful upcoming indies on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]festival's Steam page[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I'm honestly very proud of being part of such an important festival. Can't stop thanking 'The Yogscast' folks for such an amazing opportunity. I look at the rest of the games and I'm so honoured to be sharing this with them.[/p][p][/p][p]During the festival, you might see some content creators playing an exclusive sneaky demo of 'Good News'. Stay tuned, as soon after the festival there'll be more news regarding that...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604820/68fd2be3da82733fca8ed58506f5ee1d3f222ba3.png"][/img][/p]
